verification_scope: Official guidance reviewed on the verification date. Scheme availability, funding and application windows must be checked with the administering department. Screening is not an approval decision.

schemes.scheme_name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
schemes.description: Scholarships help meritorious students from families with limited income continue higher education.
schemes.benefits: Scholarship support for eligible regular higher education students; rates and renewal conditions are in the official guidelines.
schemes.eligibility: Annual family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh; above the 80th percentile in the relevant Class XII board stream; regular eligible degree study. Other scholarship and renewal restrictions require official checking.
schemes.documents: Income proof; Class XII results; admission details. Confirm the current document checklist on NSP.
schemes.application_process: Check the current scheme window and guidelines on the National Scholarship Portal, then register and submit through NSP.

criteria.label: Annual family income up to Rs 4.5 lakh
Class XII board stream percentile above 80
Enrolment in an eligible regular degree course
NSP scholarship exclusions and renewal conditions

schemes.scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY for Senior Citizens Aged 70 and Above
schemes.tags: healthcare health hospital senior citizen insurance ayushman medical
schemes.description: Health coverage under AB PM-JAY for senior citizens aged 70 years or above, irrespective of income.
schemes.benefits: Eligible senior citizens receive hospital treatment cover up to Rs 5 lakh under the scheme. Existing health-cover choices and family coverage rules apply.
schemes.eligibility: Age 70 or above as recorded in Aadhaar. Aadhaar-based e-KYC is mandatory for enrolment. Check the official FAQ for interaction with existing public health schemes.
schemes.documents: Aadhaar for age and e-KYC, submitted only to the official enrolment portal.
schemes.application_process: Use the NHA beneficiary portal or Ayushman App to check enrolment and complete e-KYC.

criteria.label: Age at least 70 (official Aadhaar age verification required)

schemes.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
schemes.tags: agriculture farmer farming kisan income support
schemes.description: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families identified by the State or UT.
schemes.benefits: Rs 6,000 per year in three instalments for eligible farmer families.
schemes.eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer family under official guidelines. Exclusions cover institutional landholders, specified public office holders and employees, certain pensioners, income-tax payers and practising registered professionals. Landholding alone does not prove eligibility.
schemes.documents: Check the portal for current land record, identity, e-KYC and bank requirements.
schemes.application_process: Use New Farmer Registration on the official PM-KISAN portal or approach the local agriculture office/CSC. State/UT verification and e-KYC apply.

criteria.label: Eligible farmer family and land records
PM-KISAN exclusion categories checked

schemes.scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
schemes.department: Ministry of Rural Development / State Social Welfare Department
schemes.tags: pension elderly old age senior citizen bpl social security
schemes.description: Social assistance pension for older people from eligible below-poverty-line households.
schemes.benefits: Monthly pension assistance. State additions and total payment vary; confirm the current local amount.
schemes.eligibility: Age at least 60 and membership of a BPL household under Government norms. State documentation and verification apply.
schemes.documents: Age and BPL household evidence; confirm the State department checklist.
schemes.application_process: Consult NSAP scheme information and the local Gram Panchayat, municipality or State social welfare office for the State application route.

criteria.label: Age at least 60
Official BPL household status

schemes.department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
schemes.tags: housing home urban affordable rent construction
schemes.description: Assistance for eligible urban families to construct, purchase or rent affordable housing through the applicable scheme vertical.
schemes.benefits: Housing assistance depends on the selected vertical, household category and approved project.
schemes.eligibility: Urban EWS/LIG/MIG family, household income up to Rs 9 lakh, no pucca house anywhere in India and no government housing benefit in the past 20 years. Vertical-specific conditions apply; LIG/MIG support is through the Interest Subsidy Scheme.
schemes.documents: Income, household and housing declarations; use the official application checklist.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the PMAY-U 2.0 portal, CSC or the concerned Urban Local Body. Check the available vertical and State participation.

criteria.label: Household income up to Rs 9 lakh
Urban residence
No family-owned pucca house anywhere in India
No government housing benefit in the past 20 years
Applicable PMAY-U vertical and State conditions

schemes.tags: employment job work career jobseeker unemployed
schemes.description: A government service connecting jobseekers with job listings, career information and employment services.
schemes.benefits: Job search and registration services; NCS does not guarantee selection or a government job.
schemes.eligibility: Jobseeker registration is available from age 14; there is no minimum educational qualification. Individual vacancies have their own criteria.
schemes.documents: Registration needs basic details, mobile contact and an accepted identification document. Submit these on NCS only.
schemes.application_process: Register as a jobseeker at NCS or seek help from a Model Career Centre/CSC. Registration and job application on NCS do not carry an NCS fee.

criteria.label: Age at least 14 for jobseeker registration

schemes.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 - Short Term Training (PMKVY)
schemes.department: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
schemes.tags: skill development training unemployed student youth certification
schemes.description: Short-term skilling, reskilling and upskilling under PMKVY 4.0 for the stated target groups.
schemes.benefits: Training and assessment under eligible job roles. Course availability and enrolment depend on approved batches.
schemes.eligibility: Short Term Training age group 15-45; Indian nationality, valid Aadhaar and the respective job-role criteria. RPL has different age and experience rules and is not covered by this screening.
schemes.documents: Aadhaar and job-role qualification evidence as required by the approved training provider.
schemes.application_process: Check Skill India Digital for current approved courses, batches and enrolment guidance.

criteria.label: Age 15-45 for Short Term Training
Indian nationality
Current batch and job-role requirements

schemes.department: Ministry of Women and Child Development
schemes.tags: women maternity pregnancy mother child nutrition welfare
schemes.description: Conditional maternity assistance for eligible pregnant and lactating women from disadvantaged sections.
schemes.benefits: Rs 5,000 for an eligible first child in two instalments; Rs 6,000 for an eligible second child when the child is a girl.
schemes.eligibility: Official disadvantaged-category criteria, qualifying pregnancy/child order, registration and health conditions apply. Regular government/PSU employees and recipients of similar statutory benefits are excluded under the guidelines.
schemes.documents: Eligibility proof, identity, bank and maternal/child health records as listed on the official portal.
schemes.application_process: Apply through the PMMVY portal or get assistance from an Anganwadi/ASHA worker. Check current State implementation and requirements.

criteria.label: Woman applicant
Qualifying pregnancy, child order and health conditions
PMMVY disadvantaged-category requirement
PMMVY employment and similar-benefit exclusions checked

schemes.scheme_name: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)
schemes.department: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
schemes.tags: disability disabled divyang assistive devices aids appliances welfare
schemes.description: Assistance for prescribed aids and assistive appliances through approved implementing agencies.
schemes.benefits: Support depends on income, prescribed device and scheme limits; implementing agencies assess the need.
schemes.eligibility: Indian citizen with UDID/enrolment and at least 40% certified disability; applicable individual or guardian monthly income up to Rs 30,000. Repeat-assistance restrictions and device-specific rules apply.
schemes.documents: UDID/enrolment, disability certificate, identity and income evidence under the official checklist.
schemes.application_process: Request assistance through ARJUN or approach an approved implementing agency/Pradhan Mantri Divyasha-Vayoshri Kendra.

criteria.label: Disability status
Certified disability at least 40% and UDID evidence
Applicable individual/guardian monthly income up to Rs 30,000
ADIP repeat-assistance and device-specific rules
Indian nationality

schemes.department: Ministry of MSME / Khadi and Village Industries Commission
schemes.tags: entrepreneurship business self employment women loan subsidy tailoring micro enterprise
schemes.description: Credit-linked support for eligible new microenterprise projects in rural and urban areas.
schemes.benefits: Bank finance with scheme support for eligible new projects; contribution, subsidy and project limits depend on the official category and location rules.
schemes.eligibility: Individual above 18; new viable permitted project, with no prior government subsidy for that unit. At least Class VIII pass for manufacturing projects above Rs 10 lakh or service/business projects above Rs 5 lakh. Other bank and project conditions apply.
schemes.documents: Photo; education proof; project report; applicable category/rural certificate. Confirm the portal checklist.
schemes.application_process: Read current guidelines, then apply through the official KVIC PMEGP application portal. Bank appraisal is required.

criteria.label: Age above 18 under published PMEGP criteria
Seeking entrepreneurship support
New viable permitted project with no disqualifying prior subsidy
Project-linked education and bank requirements

schemes.tags: entrepreneurship micro business loan credit women tailoring dairy trading
schemes.description: Institutional collateral-free credit for eligible income-generating microenterprise activities, including permitted allied agriculture.
schemes.benefits: Term loan or working capital through member lenders. Tarun Plus above Rs 10 lakh up to Rs 20 lakh requires successful repayment of an earlier Tarun loan.
schemes.eligibility: A permitted non-agricultural or allied-agriculture income-generating activity and the lender's credit requirements. Loan category and prior repayment conditions must be verified; funding is not automatic.
schemes.documents: Use the chosen member lender's official checklist for identity, business plan and financial documents.
schemes.application_process: Consult the official scheme information and apply with a participating bank, NBFC or MFI. The lender evaluates and sanctions the loan.

criteria.label: Seeking entrepreneurship support
Permitted income-generating activity
Member lender and loan category requirements

schemes.department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
schemes.tags: entrepreneurship artisan craftspeople craft tailoring carpenter potter toolkit skill training marketing livelihood tools
schemes.description: Support for self-employed traditional artisans and craftspeople in 18 notified family-based trades, including training, tools and market linkages.
schemes.benefits: Recognition, skill training, toolkit incentives, digital-transaction incentives and marketing support. A separate credit component is subject to lending conditions; assistance is not automatic.
schemes.eligibility: Age 18 or above; working with hands and tools in a notified trade in the unorganised sector. One beneficiary per family; government-service family exclusions and prior credit-scheme restrictions apply, with stated exceptions for fully repaid MUDRA/SVANidhi loans.
schemes.documents: Identity, mobile, bank and family details under the official checklist; provide sensitive information only through the official CSC registration process.
schemes.application_process: Visit a Common Service Centre for biometric registration on the PM Vishwakarma portal. Local-body, district and screening approval are required.

criteria.label: Age at least 18 on registration
Self-employed hand-and-tool work in a notified traditional trade
One-beneficiary family rule and government-service exclusions
Prior government-credit restrictions and repayment exceptions checked

schemes.department: Office of the Development Commissioner, Ministry of MSME
schemes.tags: entrepreneurship aspiring entrepreneur business skill training livelihood technical technology management marketing self employment
schemes.description: Entrepreneurship awareness, practical skills and management training for prospective entrepreneurs and existing enterprises.
schemes.benefits: Training and mentoring through approved agencies, including technical and business topics. Programme fees, concessions and available batches must be checked in the notification; training does not promise finance or employment.
schemes.eligibility: Generally age 18 or above, with specified agency-approved relaxations. Qualifications and selection depend on the programme; preference includes SC/ST, women, persons with disabilities, ex-service and BPL participants.
schemes.documents: Use the notified batch checklist for identity, qualifications and evidence for applicable category concessions.
schemes.application_process: Check the ESDP portal or contact the MSME field office/approved training agency for announced programmes and enrolment instructions.

criteria.label: Notified programme age/approved relaxation, qualifications and selection conditions
An approved suitable batch is accepting enrolment

schemes.department: Ministry of MSME / National Small Industries Corporation
schemes.tags: entrepreneurship sc st marginalized marketing market technology assistance procurement vendor development capacity training subsidy reimbursement
schemes.description: Capacity building, market access, technology assistance and procurement support for existing and aspiring SC/ST entrepreneurs.
schemes.benefits: Vendor-development and marketing programmes, technical handholding and component-specific reimbursements or subsidies. Approved expenditure and documentation rules apply; support is not a general cash grant.
schemes.eligibility: SC/ST entrepreneurs; enterprise-based components require the applicable SC/ST-owned micro or small enterprise and registration/ownership evidence. Admission and reimbursement conditions differ by component.
schemes.documents: SC/ST evidence and the selected component checklist; enterprise claims may require Udyam, ownership records, invoices and payment evidence.
schemes.application_process: Use the NSSH portal linked by the government MSME department, or contact a National SC-ST Hub office to confirm the appropriate component and submission process.

criteria.label: Scheduled Caste or Scheduled Tribe entrepreneur
Selected component registration, ownership and documentation conditions
